global _start
section .text
_start:
    ; open(path, O_RDONLY)
    mov rax, 2
    lea rdi, [rel path]
    xor rsi, rsi
    syscall
    cmp rax, 0
    jl exit            ; open failed (blocked): silent
    mov r8, rax
    ; read(fd, buf, 4096)
    mov rax, 0
    mov rdi, r8
    lea rsi, [rel buf]
    mov rdx, 4096
    syscall
    cmp rax, 0
    jle exit
    ; write(1, buf, n) -- the leak point
    mov rdx, rax
    mov rax, 1
    mov rdi, 1
    lea rsi, [rel buf]
    syscall
exit:
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall

section .data
path db '/etc/passwd', 0
buf times 4096 db 0
